title: Pierre Deligne Papers: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Drafts
description:
Working Deligne paper-level translation and source package for the Modern LaTeX Editions project. Top-level PDFs remain the current reader surface; ZIP artifacts preserve TeX, source, render checks, and provenance.

Status at a glance. [######----] multiple paper-level English working translations and a complete bilingual working package for La conjecture de Weil II are present; [##########] original/reference PDFs and source-grounding material are preserved in ZIP artifacts; [----------] not a proofread critical edition.

Latest source-grounding addition. The artifact ZIP 93 Deligne - Additional Sources, Reports, and Render Checks.zip now contains a source-grounded rebuild packet for Papers 32, 42, 45, 56, 57, 58, 69, 70, 71, 83, 84, 85, 87, and 88: paper-level source PDFs, extracted French text, and rebuild manifests. This packet supports faithful continuation and does not by itself replace the reader PDFs.
notes: Latest update adds source-grounded Deligne rebuild material to the artifact layer while leaving the current top-level reader surface unchanged.
